overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the agenda item "Spring 2014 Town Meeting Warrant Articles" was sufficiently specific because the Board reviewed the entire warrant, and the matter was closed by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the April 17, 2014 agenda item 'Spring 2014 Town Meeting Warrant Articles' was insufficiently specific, given the Board's later removal of a Building Commissioner article.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find no violation of the Open Meeting Law because the agenda item was sufficiently specific to inform the public that the entire warrant was the subject of discussion.
